$description: Shokunin Crafthouse · Semantic tokens · purpose-mapped aliases · Light + Dark modes. Every $value is a DTCG reference to a primitive — no hex or px lives in this file. The default $value resolves to the LIGHT mode value; the DARK mode value lives in $extensions.modes.dark. Build tools that don't understand the modes extension still get a valid light-mode token tree.

$metadata.modeStrategy: Each token's $value is the light-mode resolution. $extensions.modes.{light,dark} holds the full per-mode map so any DTCG processor can pick the right alias per theme. Mode-invariant tokens (spacing) repeat the same alias in both modes — explicit, no implicit fallback.
$metadata.aliasRule: Semantic tokens MUST alias primitives via the {group.subgroup.name} DTCG reference syntax. Hardcoded hex / px values in this file are a bug and will fail Sprint 1 success criterion 1b.

page.$description: Page ground. Foundation surface in both modes. Light = oatmeal warmGray.100, dark = the slate dark.surfacePage (#2C3239, OKLCH hue 252.3°, since 2026-09-24).

sunk.$description: Set-in component surface · cards, frames, tiles. scds-v2 elevation: light sits BELOW page (deeper, warmGray.200); dark SINKS to the deepest well (dark.well, one slate step below page) and rises to page on hover (Phase 2 component model). Role-named for light semantics.

deepSunk.$description: Deeper-step surface · nested states, form inputs, card hover. Light: one step beyond surface.sunk (deeper, warmGray.300). Dark: scds-v2 Phase 2 model inverts this — deepSunk is lifted a step beyond surface.raised (raised2, lighter than page), not darker than sunk/well, so nested/hover states stay visually distinct from resting card ground. Fixed 2026-07-08 — was incorrectly aliased to dark.well (collapsed onto surface.sunk, no elevation change).

raised.$description: Lifted-above-page surface · default card ground. Light = warmGray.50, dark = dark.raised1, one slate step above page. Added 2026-05-28 for the brand-site Color page (ADR brand-site-shell).

floating.$description: Highest surface · popovers, interactive-card hover. Light = warmGray.25, dark = surfaceDeepSunk. Added 2026-05-28 (ADR brand-site-shell).

rail.$description: Sidebar / left-rail ground. Light = warmGray.300; dark = floor (dark.floor — a step below page). scds-v2 remap off the retired warm dark.surfaceSunk. Added 2026-05-31 (ADR brand-site-shell sidebar pass).

hover.$description: Hover-highlight ground for nav links and similar row-level affordances. Light = warmGray.250, dark = dark.raised1. Added 2026-05-31 (ADR brand-site-shell sidebar pass).

primary.$description: Primary text · body, headlines, strong rules. AAA on every surface in both modes.

secondary.$description: Secondary text · eyebrows, metadata, descriptions. Light (warmGray.500 #5A5750): AA on surface.page (5.86:1), surface.sunk (4.77:1), surface.raised (6.40:1), surface.floating (6.86:1). USAGE RESTRICTION: must not render on surface.deepSunk, surface.rail, or surface.hover in light mode — see $extensions.usageRestrictions. Dark (dark.textSecondary, slate ladder): AA on every surface, AAA on page, sunk and rail (6.04–9.15:1), no restrictions. Light figures re-measured 2026-08-17 (ADR text-secondary-aa-sunk); dark figures 2026-09-24 (ADR dark slate ladder).

usageRestrictions.$description: forbiddenSurfaces is keyed BY MODE — a surface forbidden in light may be legal in dark and vice versa. Shape changed 2026-08-17 (was a flat array + a separate `modes` list, which could only express one union across both modes and was measurably wrong in each). Figures re-measured 2026-08-17 and guarded by scripts/verify-contrast.mjs.
usageRestrictions.reason: Light mode: deepSunk and rail (both warmGray.300) measure 3.01:1 and hover (warmGray.250) measures 3.84:1 — all below WCAG AA 4.5:1. Dark mode clears AA on every surface (6.04:1 worst case, surface.deepSunk/floating, slate ladder 2026-09-24).

tertiary.$description: Tertiary text · lowest readable tier (de-emphasized metadata). scds-v2 addition. Light = warmGray.450 (AA 4.63:1 on page, 5.06:1 raised, 5.42:1 floating); dark = dark.textTertiary, re-derived 2026-09-24 for the slate ladder to #B3B1AD — AA 6.05:1 on page, 7.22:1 sunk, 5.37:1 raised, 4.76:1 deepSunk/floating, 6.67:1 rail, clearing every dark surface including surface.raised, the default card ground. USAGE RESTRICTION: light only now — see $extensions.usageRestrictions. All figures re-measured 2026-08-17 (ADR text-secondary-aa-sunk) , 2026-09-06 (ADR brand.accentInk / dark tertiary re-derivation) and 2026-09-24 (ADR dark slate ladder).

usageRestrictions.$description: forbiddenSurfaces is keyed BY MODE — see the note on text.secondary. The previous flat list (raised/sunk/deepSunk, both modes) was wrong in BOTH directions: it forbade surface.raised in light where the pair passes at 5.06:1, and permitted rail, hover and floating where they fail. Corrected 2026-08-17. Dark emptied 2026-09-06 once dark.textTertiary was re-derived — every dark surface now clears AA.
usageRestrictions.reason: Tertiary contrast compresses below WCAG AA 4.5:1 on the compressed pairs — light: sunk 3.77:1, deepSunk/rail 2.38:1, hover 3.03:1. Dark (pre-2026-09-06, #7C7C7A) failed on raised/hover 4.40:1 and deepSunk/floating 4.16:1 — both cleared by the re-derivation to #858583 (WQ-040). The 2026-09-24 slate tier #B3B1AD reads 4.76:1 at its worst (deepSunk/floating).

disabled.$description: Disabled text · placeholders, ghosted controls. Documented exception: fails AA by spec.

onAccent.$description: Text on brand/accent fills. Pure white reads strong on teal in both modes.

default.$description: Default 1px solid hairline. Structural dividers, title block, section rules. 2026-07-28 SCDS audit Block 2 (P1-2): swapped alias with border.subtle — light mode had subtle (1.44:1) measurably stronger than default (1.22:1), inverted from dark mode's correct direction. Now 2.52:1 post warmGray P2-8 rebuild.

subtle.$description: Dashed inner divisions. Secondary structural rules inside cards and sections. 2026-07-28 SCDS audit Block 2 (P1-2): swapped alias with border.default (see above). Now 1.53:1 post warmGray P2-8 rebuild.

strong.$description: Strong frame border. Title block, masthead, asserted structural frames.

focus.$description: Focus ring color · scds-v2 dedicated, OFF the brand (teal) band and off every status hue (focus-ring-token). Cool-neutral, AA+++ per mode (light 13.24:1 / dark 10.84:1 on page; dark re-derived 2026-09-24 for the slate ladder). Was routed through the old vermilion accent, which failed AA at 11px on some grounds.

divider.$description: Content-separator hierarchy · scds-v2. rgba composed from the channel-triplet primitives (channel-triplet-rgba-tokens). Dividers separate CONTENT (rows, sections, list items) — NOT element edges; per slop-blocklist this is a content separator, not an outline-stroke violation. Dark = white 5/9/15%; light = ink 6/10/16%.

subtle.$description: Subtle divider · faintest content separation. Light ink .06 / dark white .05.

default.$description: Default divider · standard content separation. Light ink .10 / dark white .09.

strong.$description: Strong divider · asserted content separation. Light ink .16 / dark white .15.

default.$description: Resting state for interactive elements · button text + border. Ink in light, near-white in dark.

hover.$description: Hover state · primary button text/icon/border turn brand teal. ICON/BORDER ONLY as a documented AA exception (3.23:1 on surface.page — underline mitigant applies, learning #67); brand-signal use justifies. When the hover color renders as body text use interactive.hover-ink (4.72:1). Dark mode uses teal.300 since 2026-09-24 (icon/border tier: 5.51:1 on surface.page, 4.34:1 on surface.floating, its tightest dark ground); teal.400, the previous dark alias, reads 3.10:1 on the slate floating ground. 2026-08-17 re-verification: the retired vermilion this is compared against (shu.500 #C8281C) measured 4.52:1 on surface.page, not the 3.8:1 quoted here — the rebrand widened the exception considerably more than the note claimed.

hover-ink.$description: 2026-07-28 SCDS audit Block 2 (learning #56, P1-1) · text-only tier for interactive.hover — use when the hover color renders as body text (not icon/border), 4.72:1 on warmGray.100. Base interactive.hover fails AA for text at 3.23:1 (documented exception, learning #67) but is fine for icon/border use. Dark mode aliases teal.200 since 2026-09-24 (7.61:1 on surface.page, 5.99:1 on surface.floating); teal.400, the previous dark alias, reads 3.10:1 on the slate floating ground.

active.$description: Pressed/active state · one step deeper than hover. Visual color slot exists; primary press is also a scale transform (motion.scale.pressButton 0.985).

success.$description: Success state · forest green on light, lifted green on dark. Fill/border/dot tier; the dark fill clears AA on surface.page (4.74:1, slate ladder 2026-09-24). For text use status.success-ink.

warning.$description: Warning state · burnt orange on light, lifted orange on dark. Fill/border/dot tier; the dark fill clears AA on surface.page (4.73:1, slate ladder 2026-09-24). For text use status.warning-ink.

error.$description: Error state · oxblood on light, lifted rose on dark (4.63:1 on dark surface.page, slate ladder 2026-09-24; below AA as text on dark raised/floating, no -ink tier yet). Pulled deliberately off the brand band so error and brand-accent can never be confused. Originally rebound 2026-05-28 off the then-vermilion accent (ADR brand-site-shell); accent moved to teal 2026-07-09, error stays oxblood (now doubly distinct from teal).

info.$description: Info state · royal blue on light, lifted blue on dark. Fill/border/dot tier; the dark fill clears AA on surface.page (4.76:1, slate ladder 2026-09-24). For text use status.info-ink.

success-ink.$description: 2026-07-28 SCDS audit Block 2 (learning #56, P1-1) · text-only tier for status.success — use when rendered as body text, 4.74:1 (L) / 5.89:1 (D) on their respective page grounds. Base status.success fails AA for text at 3.69:1 but is fine for fill/border/dot use. Dark mode gained its own ink 2026-09-06 (WQ-041); it had reused status.success.dark, which read 4.37:1 on the retired neutral deepSunk/floating ground. Re-derived 2026-09-24 for the slate ladder; the slate status.success.dark fill reads 3.73:1 on surface.floating, so the ink stays separate.

usageRestrictions.$description: forbiddenSurfaces is keyed BY MODE. A status ink is tuned against the page ground of its own mode; the compressed light surfaces are unreachable for any status hue without abandoning the hue. Added 2026-09-06 (WQ-041), when the *-ink tiers entered check 1's AA sweep for the first time — until then no check guarded them and dark raised1, the default card ground, was failing unnoticed.
usageRestrictions.reason: Light: sunk 3.86:1, deepSunk/rail 2.44:1, hover 3.11:1 — every one below AA for the success hue. Dark cleared 2026-09-06 by the re-derivation to #3C9366, and again 2026-09-24 by the slate re-derivation to #6AC090 (4.64:1 worst case, deepSunk/floating); the reused status.success.dark it replaced read 4.37:1 on surface.deepSunk and surface.floating.

warning-ink.$description: 2026-07-28 SCDS audit Block 2 (learning #56, P1-1) · text-only tier for status.warning — use when rendered as body text, 4.58:1 (L) / 5.94:1 (D) on their respective page grounds. Base status.warning fails AA for text in light (4.21:1) and, in dark, on the raised grounds (3.72:1 on surface.floating; it clears only surface.page and the grounds below it, slate ladder 2026-09-24), but is fine for fill/border/dot use. 2026-08-17 re-verification: the light-mode base figure read 3.69:1, which is status.success.light's number copy-pasted onto the warning line — the verdict (fails AA) held, the figure did not.

usageRestrictions.$description: forbiddenSurfaces is keyed BY MODE. A status ink is tuned against the page ground of its own mode; the compressed light surfaces are unreachable for any status hue without abandoning the hue. Added 2026-09-06 (WQ-041), when the *-ink tiers entered check 1's AA sweep for the first time — until then no check guarded them and dark raised1, the default card ground, was failing unnoticed.
usageRestrictions.reason: Light: sunk 3.73:1, deepSunk/rail 2.35:1, hover 3.00:1 — every one below AA for the warning hue. Dark cleared 2026-09-06 by the re-derivation to #DC5A33, and again 2026-09-24 by the slate re-derivation to #FE9374 (4.68:1 worst case, deepSunk/floating); the retired #D2512A read 4.34:1 on surface.raised and 4.10:1 on surface.deepSunk.

info-ink.$description: 2026-07-28 SCDS audit Block 2 (learning #56, P1-1) · text-only tier for status.info — light mode reuses status.info.light directly (already AA as text, 4.79:1); dark mode gets a dedicated ink (5.97:1 on its page ground, 4.70:1 on surface.floating; re-derived 2026-09-24 for the slate ladder) since base status.info.dark reads 3.75:1 on surface.floating.

usageRestrictions.$description: forbiddenSurfaces is keyed BY MODE. A status ink is tuned against the page ground of its own mode; the compressed light surfaces are unreachable for any status hue without abandoning the hue. Added 2026-09-06 (WQ-041), when the *-ink tiers entered check 1's AA sweep for the first time — until then no check guarded them and dark raised1, the default card ground, was failing unnoticed.
usageRestrictions.reason: Light: sunk 3.90:1, deepSunk/rail 2.46:1, hover 3.14:1 — every one below AA for the info hue. Dark cleared 2026-09-06 by the re-derivation to #517DF3, and again 2026-09-24 by the slate re-derivation to #8DAFFD (4.70:1 worst case, deepSunk/floating); the retired #4A74EA read 4.37:1 on surface.raised and 4.13:1 on surface.deepSunk.

live.$description: LIVE badge fill — red broadcast signal; brightens one step on dark ground.

onLive.$description: Text on the LIVE badge fill.

progress.$description: In-progress/active pill fill + live dot — chartreuse both modes.

onProgress.$description: Ink on the chartreuse progress fill — warm near-black both modes (chartreuse stays light-valued on dark grounds).

accent.$description: Brand accent · teal kept consistent across modes for brand-mark continuity. Used for the mark, stamps, and signature surfaces — not body text.

accentDeep.$description: Brand accent deep · pressed accent state. teal.700 in both modes (5.78:1 on warmGray.100), unchanged. For accent as text, use color.brand.accentInk (added 2026-09-06, WQ-040) instead — accentDeep has no mode-following text ink: its dark value is the same teal.700, which measures only 1.62:1 on surface.raised (the slate dark.raised1 #343A41), far below AA. accentDeep stays teal.700/teal.700 because consumers depend on it as a pressed-state fill.

accentInk.$description: Brand accent as text ink · mode-following counterpart of accentDeep's light-only text claim (added 2026-09-06, WQ-040). Light = teal.700 (AA 5.78:1 on surface.page, 6.32:1 raised, 6.77:1 floating, 4.71:1 sunk); dark = teal.200 since 2026-09-24 (AA 7.61:1 on surface.page, 9.08:1 sunk, 6.76:1 raised, 5.99:1 deepSunk/floating, 8.40:1 rail) — every dark surface clears AA. teal.400, the previous dark alias, reads 3.10:1 on the slate deepSunk/floating ground. USAGE RESTRICTION: light only — see $extensions.usageRestrictions.

usageRestrictions.$description: forbiddenSurfaces is keyed BY MODE — see the note on text.tertiary. Light fails on deepSunk/rail (both warmGray.300) and hover (warmGray.250); dark clears AA on every surface (lowest measured 5.99:1, teal.200 on deepSunk/floating, 2026-09-24).
usageRestrictions.reason: Accent-as-text compresses below WCAG AA 4.5:1 in light on the low-contrast grounds — deepSunk/rail 2.97:1, hover 3.79:1. Dark (teal.200 since 2026-09-24) clears AA everywhere, lowest 5.99:1 on deepSunk/floating.

accentFill.$description: Brand accent fill · the fill for accent surfaces that carry text (primary/accent buttons). teal.600 so white text passes AA (5.20:1). brand.accent (teal.500) fails white-text AA at 3.97:1 and stays for the mark and non-text uses. Added 2026-07-09 with the teal rebrand.

text-on-inverse.$description: Sprint 4 addition · text on inverted surface. Tooltip body text and similar inverse-ground content. Near-white on light mode (atop dark Tooltip), ink on dark mode (atop light Tooltip).

surface-inverse.$description: Sprint 4 addition · inverted surface. Tooltip ground. Ink in light mode, near-white in dark mode — always the visual opposite of surface.page.

default.$description: Sprint 4 addition · default border weight (1px). Card, Input, Divider, NavBar.

focus.$description: Sprint 4 addition · focus-ring weight (2px). Every interactive component.

accent.$description: Sprint 4 addition · accent rule weight (3px). Alert left-rule, ProgressIndicator bar.

offset.$description: Sprint 4 addition · focus-ring outline offset (2px). Ground around the ring.

control.$description: Sprint 4 addition · controls that read as inscribed rather than lifted (3px). Input, Badge, Tooltip.

surface.$description: Sprint 4 addition · raised surfaces (8px). Card, Button, Alert.

surfaceLarge.$description: 2026-08-16 Figma variable sync · large raised surfaces (16px). Present in the SCDS Semantic collection (radius/surfaceLarge), absent from code. Mode-invariant. No component binds it yet — added for Figma↔code parity.

pill.$description: Sprint 4 addition · pill / circle (9999px). Avatar, Switch track + thumb, ProgressIndicator bar caps.

none.$description: Sprint 4 addition · structural rectangles, code surfaces (0).

raised.$description: Button-only neumorphic raise · 4 layers (2 ink bottom-left, 2 white top-right) composed from the channel-triplet primitives. Semantic to controls — NOT a general elevation token; no other element carries a shadow. Added 2026-07-09 with the button redesign.

inset.$description: Fill-only inset feedback · soft inner ring for interactive surfaces on hover/focus (cards, tiles). scds-v2 Phase 2 — replaces the resting stroke frame: rest carries no shadow, the inset appears only on hover/focus to narrate interactivity without an outline. Composed from the channel-triplet primitives; light = ink inner shade, dark = black inner shade + faint white top edge.

duration.$description: Sprint 4 addition · hover state-change duration (200ms). Pair with hover.easing.

easing.$description: Sprint 4 addition · strong quint-out · press feedback.

scale.$description: Sprint 4 addition · button press scale (0.985). Subtle confirmation.
Card press scale (0.995). Its own token, never aliased to the button's press: a card is a larger target and moves less. Pairs with press.duration and press.easing.

duration.$description: Sprint 5 addition · Drams #6 press-spring · release-phase duration (220ms). The button's release from scale(0.985) back to 1 — pairs with release.easing's overshoot so the return reads as a spring settle, not a snap.

easing.$description: Sprint 5 addition · Drams #6 press-spring · release-phase easing, a cubic-bezier CSS approximation of a k400/d25 spring (y > 1 overshoot). Press-in keeps motion.press.duration/.easing (160ms outStrong); only the release swaps to this pair.

scale.$description: Recede scale (0.98). The surface behind a sheet steps back while the sheet is up. Never aliased to press.scale: a recede is a state, not a touch.

opacity.$description: Recede opacity (0.6). The dim that goes with recede.scale: the surface behind a sheet fades toward the page ground while the sheet is up. Held for the sheet's life, so it takes the sheet's cut timing, not press timing.

duration.$description: Sprint 4 addition · theme switch surface + color cross-fade (380ms).

easing.$description: Sprint 4 addition · symmetric · mode switches and crossfades.

duration.$description: WQ-038 addition · act-one entrance choreography (Cinematic Direction); runs once per document (720ms). Source: studio-pm Gate-2 motion-spec — was binding directly to primitive motion.duration.orchestrated.

easing.$description: WQ-038 addition · act-one entrance choreography (Cinematic Direction); runs once per document. Source: studio-pm Gate-2 motion-spec — was binding directly to primitive motion.easing.cinematic.

duration.$description: WQ-038 addition · continuity cut — in-place content change between states (380ms). Source: studio-pm Gate-2 motion-spec — was binding directly to primitive motion.duration.standard via --sc-motion-mode-* tokens.

easing.$description: WQ-038 addition · continuity cut — in-place content change between states. Source: studio-pm Gate-2 motion-spec — was binding directly to primitive motion.easing.inOut via --sc-motion-mode-* tokens.

duration.$description: Sprint 4 addition · Tooltip enter, Alert enter, Switch thumb slide (200ms).

bar-height.$description: Sprint 4 addition · bar progress indicator height (4px).

circular.$description: Sprint 4 addition · circular progress indicator diameter (48px).

bar-height-active.$description: Sprint 5 addition · Drams #4/#5 (Volume Visible Track / Standard Volume) · interactive bar variant, active/dragging track thickness (6px). Thumbless — the track itself thickens one micro-step beyond bar-height (4px) instead of surfacing a drag handle.

hit-slop.$description: Sprint 5 addition · Drams #5 (Standard Volume) · interactive bar variant, invisible hit-area padding above/below the visual track (block padding on the interactive wrapper, not the track itself). Judgment call: the brief asked for a ~44px hit target; 44 has no home on the layout or micro ladder, so this uses micro.22 (22px) top + bottom around the 4px track = 48px total — meets/exceeds the touch-target guideline while staying token-derived. Logged in ProgressIndicator.tokens.md.

touch-target.$description: WQ-038 addition · minimum interactive hit area, 44×44 rule (#112 hit-test), nearest 8pt value. Source: studio-pm Gate-2 responsive-spec §R3 — was binding directly to primitive space.48 with no semantic alias.
